entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: A former Icatian priest from Sarpadia who broke from the Order of Leitbur and led the Farrelites.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Oliver's loyal followers who worship the Hand of Justice by brutal methods.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Group the Order of Leitbur was too lenient with.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: A young woman Oliver was infatuated with, who rejected him.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: Tymolin's brother, who became Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: Figure whose taint the Farrelites accuse others of.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Oliver was from.

entities.name: Montford
entities.description: Town where the cult took root.

entities.name: Trokair
entities.description: Town where the cult took root and which fell.

events.summary: Oliver breaks from the priesthood, finding the Order too lenient with the Ebon Hand, and gathers followers who become the Farrelites.
events.quote: Oliver broke away from the priesthood because he found the Order too lenient

events.summary: Tymolin rejects Oliver to live with her dwarven lover Kaylen.
events.quote: Tymolin rejected Oliver to live with her Dwarven lover Kaylen

events.summary: After the fall of Trokair, the cult formally breaks ties with Icatia.
events.quote: After the fall of Trokair, the cult formally broke its ties with the rest of Icatia.

events.summary: Oliver gives Sianna his mantle as champion and tries to kill Tymolin with his Aeolipile; Tev kills several members and disenchants the mantle.
events.quote: Tev responded with fury killing several members and disenchanting the mantle off of Sianna.

events.summary: Oliver stabs Tymolin to death after she refuses to rejoin him.
events.quote: when she refused stabbed her to death

events.summary: Tev, newly transformed as Tevesh Szat, incinerates everyone present including Oliver and Sianna; the Farrelites consider them martyrs.
events.quote: Enraged at his sister's death, Tev appeared as the newly transformed Tevesh Szat
